verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a REST API for setting up/scaling pipelines and managing accounts programmatically, plus a Connector SDK and an MCP server (read/write/delete scopes) that can query sync status, copy connections, etc., showing broad API coverage beyond simple monitoring. However, there is no explicit documentation claiming full UI/API parity, no OpenAPI spec discoverable (openapi.json/swagger.json all 404), and one community report calls the APIs 'unreliable' and prone to random failures, suggesting real-world gaps rather than complete parity. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or changelog showing every UI action (e.g., dashboard alerts, deployment agent management, billing/plan changes) is also API-accessible, and independent confirmation that the API is as reliable/complete as the UI.
